asset.name: BulkActionBar
asset.description: The contextual action surface activated by selection, showing counts and scope, guarding destructive operations, and reporting progress, partial failure, and cancellation.

requires.reason: Selection uses the shared model with stable identities across paging and reorder.
Long-running bulk work reports progress through the shared component.

rationale: Partial failure is the defining case: a bulk operation over two hundred records where six fail must report which six and offer a path for them, not a single red banner.
